name: team-22-root-build
description: Root build script for Vercel deployment

scripts.build: export NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 && cd frontend/web && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build
scripts.vercel-build: export NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 && cd frontend/web && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build
